consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: identification of every energy source for the task

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: regulator directive concerning danger tagging at ML-3201

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the identification of every energy source for the task on ML-3201 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in applying and verifying an isolation, specifically applying locks, tags and personal danger tags. ML-3201 (grinding mills) is in service for two-line ball milling. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the identification of every energy source for the task was in place but did not perform. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 19 July 2009 a regulatory notice was issued concerning ML-3201 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility following cleaning and preparation.
